change_log.value: Consent API and Tool Router Integration

SHARED-F-2-S25.title: Consent Schema and Storage Contract
SHARED-F-2-S25.description: Define and implement the data schema and storage contract for consent records, including tier designation, timestamping, user/session linkage, and flags for de-identified vs full data storage. Ensure compatibility with MongoDB persistence patterns and downstream services (lead capture, debug logging).

SHARED-F-2-S26.title: Consent API and Tool Router Integration
SHARED-F-2-S26.description: Expose consent framework via backend API endpoints and integrate enforcement into tool_router to ensure all tool executions respect consent tier. Include request validation, consent gating before tool execution, and propagation of consent state through chat sessions.
